title: QUIC RFC 9000 Client 0-RTT Updated Transport-Parameter Packet-Use Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused S7P4P1 requirement-home tests over client 0-RTT packet-use decisions for remembered versus updated transport-parameter values and server optional PROTOCOL_VIOLATION handling, plus Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the internal policy that constrains 0-RTT packet construction to remembered transport-parameter values, scopes updated values to 1-RTT packet construction, and exposes the server's optional PROTOCOL_VIOLATION result for detected updated-value use in 0-RTT.
expected_result: The focused tests show remembered transport-parameter values are accepted for 0-RTT packet use, updated handshake and 1-RTT-frame values are rejected for 0-RTT use with PROTOCOL_VIOLATION semantics, updated values are accepted only for 1-RTT packet use, unknown provenance fails closed, and the server helper returns PROTOCOL_VIOLATION only for updated-value sources.
procedure: Run the focused S7P4P1 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The client remembered transport-parameter subset and prohibited-parameter handshake-value policy are already traced under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0068 and ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0070.
The runtime's public early-data admission remains closed.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim public early-data APIs, TLS early_data extension admission wiring, anti-replay behavior, 0-RTT decryption, application-data delivery, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S7P4P1 filter passed 20/20, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0010 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0013 trace_clean and reports 1,274 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 457 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,503/4,503, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
